title: Apple Executive in Charge of iPhone's Camera App Reportedly Retires
content:
Apple's vice president of camera and photo software engineering Jon McCormack retired at the end of October after more than eight years at the company, according to Bloomberg's Mark Gurman. The report said he oversaw the iPhone's Camera and Photos apps and their underlying technologies, so his departure is notable.
This article, "Apple Executive in Charge of iPhone's Camera App Reportedly Retires" first appeared on MacRumors.com
